zh.stance: 承诺远超到位资金，风险集中在两家实验室的履约节奏
zh.verdict: 图里 $1.84T 的算力采购承诺中，已约束的只有 $254B（约 14%），其余是 "up to"、意向书与多年总额；买方端 92% 的 Oracle 在手合同来自 OpenAI 一家。OpenAI 是 $730B 采购承诺对 $114B 已到位股权和 $5.2B 债务；Anthropic 是 $506B 承诺（其中对 Google 的 $114B 已按 S-1 口径约束为 take-or-pay）对 $66B 已到位股权。债务大多落在 SPV / 项目层（约 $301B）并由芯片厂商的残值担保兜底（NVIDIA $105B、Broadcom $29B），公司层投资级债的到期集中在 2030 年以后。
evidence: 订单：标题口径 $1.84T，已约束 $254B；另有 40 笔 GW 级或战略性合同未披露金额。
集中度：Oracle 在手合同 HHI 0.846（OpenAI 占 92%）；Microsoft 在手 $280B、CoreWeave 在手 $58B 的已约束口径均为 0。
担保：9 条担保，可量化敞口 $155B；NVIDIA 对 OpenAI 4.25 GW 租约的累计付款上限 $105B 要到 2028 年起租才生效，Broadcom 对 Anthropic 租赁 SPV 的兜底按 10-Q 约 $29B。
闭环：已约束口径 15 条资金闭环（Amazon↔OpenAI、Amazon↔Anthropic、Google↔Anthropic、Broadcom↔Anthropic 等），投资方、贷款方与采购方是同一批公司。

watch.if: OpenAI 在 2027 年 Oracle 合同起始前没有新的大额股权或债务到位（现有已到位 $114B 对 $720B 承诺）
watch.then: 压力先落在为它建设的开发商项目贷款上：Vantage Frontier $23B、Vantage Lighthouse $15B、Crusoe Abilene $7.1B、Project Jupiter $18B 的还款依赖 Oracle 租金，而 Oracle 租金依赖 OpenAI 付款
watch.watch: OpenAI 下一轮融资公告；Oracle 10-Q 里的 RPO 与客户集中度披露；上述项目贷款的评级动作

watch.if: Anthropic 的 TPU 租约出现欠付（Broadcom 兜底的触发条件是租约违约，负债 = 85% 欠付额 − 机架处置价值）
watch.then: $43.5B 一级贷款的信用风险从 SPV 转移到 Broadcom 资产负债表，Broadcom 自身 $18.5B 公募债的持有人会同时重新定价
watch.watch: Anthropic S-1 之后的季度收入披露；Broadcom 10-Q 中 backstop 敞口的变动

watch.if: 芯片厂商按部署分期的股权投资（NVIDIA、AMD 对 OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI）与被投方的采购分期同步放缓
watch.then: 16 条闭环会让订单与投资两端同时缩水，图上会表现为 EQUITY 与 ORDER 的 firm 口径同时下降而 headline 不变
watch.watch: NVIDIA 与 AMD 下一次财报附注里的投资承诺余额；OpenAI / Anthropic 的 GW 部署进度

zh.note: 以上是条件式提示，只陈述图中可核的事实与触发条件，不构成对任何主体的评级或投资建议。

en.stance: Commitments far exceed funded capital; the risk sits in two labs' delivery schedules
en.verdict: Of $1.84T in compute purchase commitments on the map, only $254B (about 14%) is firm; the rest is "up to", letters of intent or multi-year totals. On the buyer side, 92% of Oracle's contracted backlog comes from OpenAI alone. OpenAI carries $730B of commitments against $114B of funded equity and $5.2B of debt; Anthropic carries $506B (of which $114B to Google is firm take-or-pay per its S-1) against $66B of funded equity. Most debt sits at the SPV / project level (about $301B) and is backstopped by chip vendors' residual-value guarantees (NVIDIA $105B, Broadcom $29B); corporate investment-grade maturities cluster after 2030.
evidence: Orders: $1.84T headline, $254B firm; 40 further GW-scale or strategic contracts have no disclosed amount.
Concentration: Oracle backlog HHI 0.846 (OpenAI 92%); Microsoft's $280B and CoreWeave's $58B backlogs have zero firm amount.

Guarantees: 9 guarantee edges, $155B quantifiable; NVIDIA's $105B cap on OpenAI's 4.25 GW lease only becomes effective at lease start in 2028; Broadcom's backstop of Anthropic's lease SPV is about $29B per its 10-Q.
Loops: 15 firm-basis funding loops (Amazon↔OpenAI, Amazon↔Anthropic, Google↔Anthropic, Broadcom↔Anthropic…); investors, lenders and buyers are the same companies.

watch.if: OpenAI raises no major new equity or debt before the Oracle contract starts in 2027 ($114B funded vs $720B committed)
watch.then: pressure lands first on the developer project loans built for it: Vantage Frontier $23B, Vantage Lighthouse $15B, Crusoe Abilene $7.1B, Project Jupiter $18B all depend on Oracle rent, which depends on OpenAI payments
watch.watch: OpenAI's next funding announcement; RPO and customer-concentration disclosures in Oracle's 10-Q; rating actions on those project loans

watch.if: Anthropic's TPU leases go into arrears (Broadcom's backstop triggers on lease default; liability = 85% of arrears minus rack disposal value)
watch.then: credit risk on the $43.5B first lien moves from the SPV to Broadcom's balance sheet, and Broadcom's own $18.5B of public bonds reprice with it
watch.watch: Anthropic's quarterly revenue after the S-1; changes in backstop exposure in Broadcom's 10-Q

watch.if: chip vendors' staged equity (NVIDIA, AMD into OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) slows in step with the investees' staged purchases
watch.then: the 16 loops shrink orders and investments together: firm EQUITY and ORDER fall while headline stays flat
watch.watch: investment-commitment balances in NVIDIA's and AMD's next filings; OpenAI / Anthropic GW deployment progress

en.note: Conditional flags only: verifiable facts from the map plus their triggers. Not a rating of any party and not investment advice.
